adds.title: City of Philadelphia gender-identity ordinances and sanctuary executive order - Mayor Jim Kenney
adds.summary: On October 17, 2023, Philadelphia Mayor Jim Kenney declared Philadelphia a sanctuary for gender-affirming care by executive order banning use of city resources to investigate or punish in-state and out-of-state residents seeking gender-affirming care in the city, deprioritizing enforcement of any future state or federal restrictions, and shielding travelers from out-of-state enforcement.

adds.title: Rhode Island anti-discrimination law - sexual orientation (1995), gender identity or expression (2001), healthcare expansion (June 2023)
adds.summary: Rhode Island prohibits discrimination based on gender identity or expression as an unfair employment practice and prohibits such discrimination in credit, housing, and public accommodations under R.I. Gen. Laws §§ 28-5-3, 28-5-7, 34-37-4, 34-37-4.3, 11-24-2 (2001).

adds.title: Rhode Island hate crimes criminal statute - penalty enhancements
adds.summary: Rhode Island hate-crime law explicitly covers violence based on gender identity under R.I. Gen. Laws § 42-28-46 (2012).
